name: Flipside Fairytales: Sleeping Beauty
source:
Ozhá, Shahina, Oyimahina, and Lehina are fairies serving the Juvela kingdom. Ozhá does things their own way, however, and sometimes gets in trouble with the king and queen...

[From [url=https://moosader.itch.io/flipside-fairytale-sleeping-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Ozhá、Shahina、Oyimahina和Lehina是侍奉Juvela王国的精灵。可是，Ozhá总有自己的一套做法，有时会因此惹恼国王与王后……

[来源：[url=https://moosader.itch.io/flipside-fairytale-sleeping-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
